project.title: Window Decision
project.safety_boundary: one fictional adult character; no identity redesign
project.source_of_truth: two user-supplied references plus this Prompt IR

references.role: identity reference for the woman in the cobalt coat

anti_misread: do not add a second person

entities.external_name: the woman in the cobalt coat
entities.starting_state: standing beside the table and looking through the window

identity: same face, hair, coat, and proportions
product_or_prop: one ceramic cup remains on the table
scene: same window, table, rainy exterior, and camera side
palette_material: cool daylight, warm ceramic cup, natural skin tone
lens_grammar: one motivated camera move per shot
audio_spine: rain ambience and one cup contact sound

composition.visual_center: the woman's eyes and the window reflection
composition.subject_hierarchy: woman first, cup second, rain third
composition.foreground_midground_background: soft door edge, woman and table, rainy window
composition.movement_room: space between the woman and the table
composition.screen_direction: the woman remains frame-left facing right
composition.narrative_purpose: turn hesitation into one visible decision

lighting.condition: soft overcast window light from camera-right

optics.condition: no special optical effect is required

grade.condition: neutral balance with restrained cool-warm separation

render_look.exit_or_continuity: the light direction and neutral base remain continuous

entity_actions.path: lower her gaze to the cup and take one quiet breath
entity_actions.final_state: right hand hovering beside the cup

environment_action.response: one brighter reflection passes across the window

camera.angle_height_axis: eye level on the established axis
camera.lens_feel_reason: natural perspective keeps the room readable
camera.path: slow lateral move toward the woman's eyes
camera.motivation: move attention from weather to decision

shot_blocks.composition_state: woman frame-left, cup center, window depth frame-right
shot_blocks.look_delta: window reflection briefly brightens without changing color
shot_blocks.transition_out: cut on her gaze toward the cup

entity_actions.trigger: her gaze settles on the door
entity_actions.path: lift the cup once, set it down closer to the door, then turn her shoulders right
entity_actions.physical_consequence: the cup makes one soft ceramic contact

environment_action.response: door-edge foreground shifts as she turns

camera.angle_height_axis: eye level on the same axis
camera.path: one rack focus from the cup to her eyes
camera.motivation: connect the physical choice to the emotional turn

shot_blocks.composition_state: preserve frame-right exit room and the upper-right negative space
shot_blocks.transition_out: hold the resolved expression for the final second

transition_plan.visual_bridge: the woman's eyeline leads to the cup
transition_plan.continuity_state: identity, axis, cup, and light direction remain unchanged
transition_plan.risk: an extra person or changed cup may appear

units.audio_handoff: rain and cup cue remain in post-production
